item.stem:
[Image: A graph of car production with time on the x-axis and total number of cars produced on the y-axis. Time goes from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. in one hour increments. Total number of cars produced goes from 0 to 400 in intervals of 50. A straight dotted line is drawn on the graph, going from the origin at 0 cars at 8 a.m., to the top right of the graph, at 4:00p.m. and 400 cars. A solid line is shown starting at the origin and going above the dotted line after 8:00a.m. and before 11:30 a.m. The solid line then goes below the dotted line from 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. It again goes above the dotted line from 1:30 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. and ends at 400 cars at 4:00 p.m.]

The solid line (——) on the graph shows car production by the NU Car Motor Company during a particular day.

The dotted line (-----) shows what the total number of cars produced would be if the rate of production were constant.

B. What was the average number of cars produced per hour on this day?

Answer: ____

item.figure_description: A line graph titled "Car Production". The horizontal axis is labeled "Time" with marked points for 8 am, 9 am, 10 am, 11 am, 12 noon, 1 pm, 2 pm, 3 pm, and 4 pm. The vertical axis is labeled "Total Number of Cars Produced" with grid marks from 0 to 400 in increments of 50. A dashed line segment runs directly from (8 am, 0) to (4 pm, 400). A solid line connects the points (8 am, 0), (9 am, 100), (10 am, 150), (1 pm, 200), (2 pm, 350), and (4 pm, 400).

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.
